ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a raider's past
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} rode with raiders for years before coming here, burning farms and taking what wasn't {PAWN_possessive}, and did worse things that {PAWN_pronoun} still won't talk about.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked late, out by the wall. {B_nameDef} came back in alone and sat by the fire a long while before going to bed.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} waited until the grave was filled in. Every day here, {TELLER_pronoun} said, {PAWN_nameDef} had tried to undo some of what came before, and the others had a right to know what that was.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: noble blood
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was born to a great house on another world, and walked away from a fortune and a title to end up here, hauling stone in the mud.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} was born to a great house in a far-off land, and walked away from a fortune and a title to end up here, hauling stone in the mud.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} a ring {A_pronoun} keeps on a cord under {A_possessive} shirt, then tucked it away again.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} took a ring on a cord from around {PAWN_nameDef}'s neck before the burial, and told the others whose seal it was:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a deserter
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} deserted. In the middle of a battle, {PAWN_pronoun} dropped {PAWN_possessive} weapon and ran, and left {PAWN_possessive} comrades to die.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} about an old battle, in a voice that barely carried, and asked {B_objective} to stand close by the next time there's fighting.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} never ran again, not once in all the fights here, and then told the others about the one time {PAWN_pronoun} did:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a doctor's mistake
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} once gave a patient twice the dose that was written down, and the patient died before morning. {PAWN_nameDef} was gone before anyone could ask questions, and still goes over that night, step by step.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} watched {B_nameDef} tend a wound, and afterwards told {B_objective} a story about another patient, a long time ago.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} read every label twice and measured every dose by lamplight, and now the others might as well know the reason.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a child left behind
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: When everything fell apart, {PAWN_nameDef} left a child behind somewhere out among the stars. {PAWN_nameDef} has no idea whether the child is still alive.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: When everything fell apart, {PAWN_nameDef} left a child behind somewhere far from here. {PAWN_nameDef} has no idea whether the child is still alive.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} carved a little wooden horse one evening and wouldn't say who it was for. Later, alone with {B_nameDef}, {A_pronoun} did.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} looked for one face in every caravan that came through, and told the others whose:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a price on their head
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} is wanted for murder on {PAWN_possessive} homeworld. There's a bounty, and {PAWN_pronoun} has been running from it ever since.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} is wanted for murder back home. There's a price on {PAWN_possessive} head, and {PAWN_pronoun} has been running from it ever since.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} pulled {B_nameDef} aside when a stranger came by asking questions, and the two of them talked for a long time once the stranger had gone.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} can stop running now, and told the others what {PAWN_pronoun} had been running from:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a cult
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} once belonged to a cult that prayed to something in the dark between the stars. {PAWN_nameDef} says that's over, but on some nights {PAWN_pronoun} still says the prayers under {PAWN_possessive} breath, in a tongue no one here speaks.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {B_nameDef} heard {A_nameDef} murmuring in the dark one night and asked about it. {A_nameDef} told {B_objective}, and asked {B_objective} to forget it.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: "{PAWN_nameDef} fought it every night," {TELLER_nameDef} said at the graveside, and then told the others what it was.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a pirate's debt
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} owes a small fortune to a pirate lord, lost at cards in one bad night years ago, and the pirates have never stopped asking after it.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} jumped at the sight of a trader's banner, and later explained to {B_nameDef} why. {B_nameDef} has been checking the banners too since.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said the pirates will have to whistle for their money now, and told the others what {PAWN_nameDef} owed:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a borrowed name
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: "{PAWN_nameDef}" isn't {PAWN_possessive} real name. It belonged to a traveler who died on the road here, and was taken along with the traveler's papers.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} a name the others have never heard, and {B_nameDef} said it back once, quietly, as if to keep it safe.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} asked for two names on the grave marker, and then had to explain the second one.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the food that went missing
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: For months, {PAWN_nameDef} has been taking food from the stores at night, a few bites at a time, and eating it alone in the dark.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} offered {B_nameDef} a piece of dried fruit late at night, and somewhere in the conversation that followed explained where it came from.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: The food will stop going missing now, {TELLER_nameDef} said, and told the others where it had been going.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: can't read
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} can't read. All those times {PAWN_pronoun} nodded at a book or a sign, {PAWN_pronoun} was guessing.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} to read a note aloud "because the light's bad," and then, after a while, admitted the real reason.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} read the words on the grave marker aloud, one at a time, the way {PAWN_nameDef} would have needed them read.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: afraid of the dark
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} is terrified of the dark. Every night since arriving, {PAWN_pronoun} has slept with a small light hidden under the blanket.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} to sit up with {A_objective} during a dark night, and they talked until the candle burned down.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} left a small lamp burning on {PAWN_nameDef}'s grave that first night, and kept it lit until morning.

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: a hidden kindness
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was the one mending boots and leaving them by the beds, putting out extra blankets in winter and laying flowers on the graves, and never wanted anyone to know.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: Late one night, {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} for help with "a small job", and swore {B_objective} to secrecy before they started.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} laid flowers on {PAWN_nameDef}'s grave the morning after, and said it was only fair, since {PAWN_pronoun} had laid so many:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: secret poems
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} has been writing poems about the other colonists, dozens of them, kept in a bundle under the bed. Some are beautiful, and some are far too honest.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} read {B_nameDef} something from a folded paper, then folded it up again. {B_nameDef} blushed for the rest of the evening.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} brought a bundle of paper to the grave, and read one page aloud before telling the others what the rest were:
